elements.title: JCS canonicalisation (RFC 8785)
elements.spec: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme. One deterministic byte form for a JSON object, so two parties hash the same thing. The base every reference and receipt binds to.

elements.title: Content-addressed references
elements.spec: Deterministic SHA-256-over-JCS identifiers (action_ref, card_ref, task_ref, artifact_ref, delegation/journey/revocation refs). Tamper-evident, offline-checkable, no JWS/JWKS required to resolve.

elements.title: RFC 9421 HTTP signatures + RFC 9530 Content-Digest
elements.spec: HTTP Message Signatures and Content-Digest. Ed25519 (+ECDSA P-256/P-384) signing/verification of requests and responses, with SSRF-guarded keyid resolution.

elements.title: Post-quantum cryptography
elements.spec: ML-DSA / ML-KEM (NIST FIPS 203/204) and Falcon-1024 (FIPS 206), classical+PQ hybrid. The substrate-author layer and the licensed AV-VCS engine; classical path stays usable when PQ is absent.

elements.title: Payment-lifecycle receipt / evidence formats
elements.spec: payment-mandate, settlement-attestation, refund, cancellation, Payment Evidence Frame (PEF), composite trust-query. Signed, fail-closed, offline-verifiable evidence of a payment decision or outcome.

elements.title: Keystone composition (L2) / Fabric spine
elements.spec: The Keystone SDK and the algovoi-fabric composition spine: bind authority -> policy -> decision -> delegation -> outcome into one tamper-evident, fail-closed chain.

elements.title: Cross-language conformance / cross-validation
elements.spec: Signed, byte-for-byte conformance batteries across independent implementations (the 10-language moat). A planted mutant must fail; the bytes decide, not the prose.

elements.title: Offline third-party verification / audit
elements.spec: Standalone verifiers and audit bundles a relying party can run with no AlgoVoi service in the loop: verify.algovoi.co.uk, verify-it-yourself, evidence readers, reseal-verify.

elements.title: Key identity / DID / credential binding
elements.spec: did:key / did:web resolution, key-to-credential binding (RFC 9421), key hygiene / primality soundness, rotation lineage. Who a key is, and what it is allowed to sign.

elements.title: On-chain settlement / state proofs / bridges (AVM)
elements.spec: Algorand & Voi mesh settlement receipts argued from state proofs, portable proofpacks, mainnet bridges, consensus blocklist, multi-chain wallet auth.

elements.title: Agent payment protocols (AP2 / ACP / x402 / MPP / A2A)
elements.spec: Adapters and reference implementations for the agent-payment protocols: AP2 mandates, ACP checkout, x402 paid HTTP, MPP, A2A message/artifact/task refs, MCP tool surface.

elements.title: Hosted gateway / pay rail / platform adapters
elements.spec: The hosted x402 gateway (api.algovoi.co.uk), the pay rail (pay.algovoi.co.uk), the platform, and the ecommerce / marketplace / AI-agent / no-code adapters.
